selection: Complete unchanged test file; no subtest filtering, assertion edits, sharding or opt-in native/compiler run.
result_predicates: complete normal prove result All tests successful and Files=1
retain entire verbose TAP and OS resource report; report OS measurements without treating them as independently captured per-process peaks

passive_samples.scope: Observation-time owned PID/parent/RSS/VSZ only; raw whole-host vm_stat, hw.memsize and kern.memorystatus_vm_pressure_level may be retained. ps RSS/VSZ are KiB; do not infer allocation causality or historical cutoff values from later samples.
passive_samples.timing: UTC and monotonic stamps on each sample; no signals, sampling profiler, unrelated argv/environment capture or host-policy change.

claims.rederive: Exact current/native Git source identity and canonical AXI generated contracts; whole test remains its own unchanged oracle.
claims.falsify: Retain full3 original137 and missing outcome; focused failure/guard trip cannot satisfy normal predicates. Later success cannot prove original allocation cause or historical macOS startup repair.
claims.durability: Tracked plan and source identities, existing self-retained instrument/journal/full output/status, sample observations, task/book and normal gated commit.
